rules.name: provider-native-first
rules.when: a connected native app directly supports the provider and requested action

rules.name: deterministic-local-first
rules.when: the task is deterministic, bounded, local, and does not need an autonomous loop

rules.name: long-local-task
rules.when: the task requires repeated inspect-act-verify cycles or multi-file repair

rules.name: browser-deterministic
rules.when: browser work is scripted/replayable and persistent interactive state is not required

rules.name: browser-stateful
rules.when: browser work needs persistent session state, accessibility-tree introspection, or interactive exploration

rules.name: mcp-gateway
rules.when: the host exposes custom MCP and the request is capability discovery, status, receipt retrieval, or a guarded mutation supported by the bridge
